I want to have the ability to delete a namespace using PHP-SDK

### Describe the solution you'd like

There is already working OperatorServiceClient in the SDK, but it's not used anywhere, so in order to use it I need to reimplement BaseClient.

comments.body: @shanginn would you like to implement it?
sure why not. I don't think I have a use for it anymore but I'll give it a try over the weekend

I gave it a shot, but it seems more work that I expected. I don't want to ship slop and don't have the time needed to test it and do it properly. I have saved my work [here](https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-php/pull/737/changes), but don't think anyone should see it :)

for the time being I will not continue on this one, sorry
I'll continue developing the branch, some changes are needed. Overall, thanks for the work!
